definition: Token-weighted mean training cross entropy of the selected epoch, in nats. Training mode uses dropout.
Token-weighted validation cross entropy recomputed from the selected checkpoint, in nats.
exp(validation cross entropy).
validation cross entropy / ln(2).
selected-epoch validation cross entropy minus selected-epoch training cross entropy.
Correct argmax next-character predictions divided by evaluated validation targets.
Unique generated character 1-grams divided by total generated character 1-grams.
Unique generated character 2-grams divided by total generated character 2-grams.
Unique generated character 3-grams divided by total generated character 3-grams.

For one generated continuation, a 4-gram position is repeated when the same four characters occurred at a strictly earlier position in that same continuation. The sample rate is repeated positions divided by the number of 4-gram positions. The reported rate is the unweighted mean of the sample rates. Prompts are excluded.
Mean pre-clip global L2 gradient norm over optimizer steps 1 through 31260.
Sum of per-epoch spike counts for epochs 1 through 20.
Non-finite training loss or gradient events across both runs.
Trainable parameter count of the GPT.
Target tokens during optimizer steps 1 through 31260 divided by those steps' wall time.
Median of 5 greedy generation timings on the selected checkpoint.
Larger of the epoch 1-10 process peak RSS and the epoch 11-20 process peak RSS.
Sum of the epoch 1-10 training wall time and the epoch 11-20 training wall time. The pause between processes is excluded.
Wall time of the original run from the start of epoch 1 through the end of epoch 10 validation.
Wall time of the continuation from the start of epoch 11 through the end of epoch 20 validation.
Epoch whose validation cross entropy was lowest. Final generation and validation metrics use that checkpoint.
